name: shadcn-chat
summary: Chat components for React and shadcn/ui: chat window, message events, header and toolbar, added with a CLI.
description: A package for adding customizable chat components to React apps: a chat window with header, message events (avatar, title, content, timestamp), a sticky message-composition toolbar with addons, and a one-command install that adds a wired-up chat page. The repo includes a Vercel AI SDK chatbot example; the author notes the library is no longer actively maintained.
contains: chat window components: header, messages, toolbar
message parts: event, addon, body, title, content, avatar, time
message toolbar with textarea, addons, buttons (Enter to submit)
one CLI command installs a wired-up chat page
Vercel AI SDK chatbot example in the repo
